desc: Verify the formula (sum of top ⌊N/2⌋ − sum of bottom ⌊N/2⌋) against an O(N²) interval-DP brute force via random stress testing on small N (≤12), covering even/odd N and varied value ranges; report agreement or counterexamples.
Implement final O(N log N) Python solution (fast stdin via sys.stdin.buffer, sort, compute difference of sums, print).
Sanity-check final solution logic against the three samples (expect 5, 14, 0) and confirm performance is fine for N=3×10⁵.
